meta.source: MoSPI, National Statistical Office (Annual Survey of Industries)
meta.revisionPolicy: ASI results are final on release; occasional revisions get a fresh vintage.
meta.product: Annual Survey of Industries, NIC 2008 block
meta.coverage: All India, every 4-digit NIC class, every indicator, 2008-09 to 2023-24 (NIC 2008 block)
meta.note: The NIC-2008 classification block, a separate ruler from every other block (never joined). Values as published: money in ₹ lakh (nominal; fuel values in ₹ thousand where the source says so), counts plain, mandays in thousands. Survey years are financial years, dated at April of the first. A class missing in a year was not reported separately that year. The 2023-24 four-digit copies of the All-industries rows of indicators 36 to 49 arrive shifted by one indicator; at All India they are outvoted by the clean 2- and 3-digit copies (see asi-accounts). Quarantined: in 2023-24 the source serves indicators 36 to 49 of this table shifted one code down (persons engaged stops adding up from workers, other employees and unpaid members, and adds up again read one code up); those cells of indicators 36 to 50 are left out, and the raw archive keeps them as served.
